lines: A trusted source has informed us that a party was held in an estate outside the city borders.
At this party, spoiled food was served.
As abhorrent as this claim is, it was backed up by photographs, which I can only describe as a facsimile of Verehnian cuisine, but left to rot to a disgusting degree.
This fact was seemingly ignored by the attendees as they happily gorged on these revolting dishes.
More photographs show that some of these attendees are high-ranking party officials, so these signs only point to one thing.
Not only are the ruling party rotten in their actions, but some seem to be Spoiled as well, and actively indulging in their perverted and unnatural urges themselves.
This event mirrors similar parties thrown by the nobles that fanned the flame of Svetka's revolution long ago, but sadly, history has a habit of repeating itself.
